summary: Make BuilderOS self-repairing, self-scheduling, and self-learning, then install the remaining constitutional protocols as runtime services and close competitive gaps.

phases.title: Competitive benchmark harness and IDE bridge
Chair/Council pipeline as runtime entry gate

steps.title: Lock blueprint and acceptance tests
required_edits: Create a machine-readable blueprint with phases and steps.
Define acceptance tests for deterministic repair, lessons capture, scheduling, and constitutional runtime services.
Create a human-readable task list.

steps.title: Create deterministic BUILD_QUEUE drift repair executor
required_edits: Scan all docs/products/<product>/BUILD_QUEUE.json files for pending steps whose dependencies are done.

For each artifact-proof failure, attempt a deterministic repair: missing file_contains -> add comment anchor; missing export -> add alias or safe stub; route path mismatch -> add alias route; missing auto-register entry -> update config/auto-registered-product-modules.json; missing db/migration -> generate grounded SQL; missing services/routes file -> generate minimal grounded stub from BUILD_QUEUE spec.
Reject repairs that touch production auth/money/data or that are not derivable from the BUILD_QUEUE contract.
Return a repair receipt with ok/fail, class, lesson, and file changes.

steps.title: Wire repair executor into never-stop factory
required_edits: When a product build step fails artifact proof and is repair-class, invoke the drift repair executor before escalating.
If the repair succeeds, re-evaluate artifact proof and continue the queue.
If the repair fails or is unsafe, escalate to BLOCKED and log a lesson.

steps.title: Create build-queue drift lessons log
required_edits: Every repair attempt writes a JSONL line with ts, product, step_id, target_file, failure_class, attempted_fix, result, reason, root_cause, verification_command.
Lessons report can aggregate by failure family and recommend blueprint amendments.
Improvement loop consumes recurring failure families and emits governed improvement proposals.

steps.title: Build overnight self-scheduling daemon
required_edits: Daemon must be safe to run unattended: check useful-work guard, run self-heal, run drift repair, run bp-priority:once, record lessons, and stop if no work or if budget/daily cap hit.
Run at a configurable interval (e.g. 5 minutes) in Railway or via Railway cron.
Log every cycle to data/bp-priority-never-stop-log.jsonl and data/never-stop-product-factory-log.jsonl.
Halt on repeated identical failure signatures to avoid token/usage waste.

steps.title: Install runtime constitutional protocol services
required_edits: Knowledge/Judgment split: service that separates facts from inferences and tags outputs.
Goal decomposition: service that breaks a mission into sub-goals and tracks dependencies.
Cognitive-spine health metrics: service that tracks reasoning depth, model fatigue, confidence drift, and consensus quality.
Asset-evolution governance: service that tracks file lineage, SSOT amendments, and deprecated patterns.
Reality hierarchy reconciler: service that compares SENTRY, receipts, production behavior, and customer data against Chair consensus and flags divergence.
Founder cognitive-load optimizer: service that decides when to ask Adam vs. when to act, based on cost_of_error and reversibility.
Wire these into chair-lumin-unified.js and reasoning-plan.mjs where natural.
Add tests under npm run builder:preflight.

steps.title: Clear remaining 11 pending BUILD_QUEUE steps
required_edits: Use the drift repair executor to attempt deterministic fixes for all 11 pending steps.
For steps that need model codegen, park them with a clear blocker class and a lesson.
For steps blocked on missing Railway env vars, do not fake the integration; record the blocker.

steps.title: Empirical benchmark harness and IDE bridge
required_edits: Benchmark harness: run a small intent->deployed-feature task with BuilderOS and a one-shot baseline, measure time, cost, SENTRY pass, and intent drift.
IDE bridge: expose builder commands over WebSocket/HTTP and provide a minimal VS Code extension manifest.
Report results with receipts.

steps.title: ChatGPT conversation audit integration
required_edits: Capture the 5/10 rating, gaps, and prioritized fixes from the ChatGPT conversation audit.
Add branch-divergence guard (FRA-007-A) and canonical pass/fail gate (FRA-007-B) to the deploy/commit pipeline.
Add independent GAP-FILL verification (FRA-007-C) and scheduled prod-degraded probe (FRA-007-D).
Extend model capability ledger role coverage (FRA-007-E) and Founder Intent Model predict/compare (FRA-007-F).
Defer Import Memory to a separate product mission.

steps.title: Blueprint Authority & Completeness Validator
required_edits: Create a validator that fails if any protected source file lacks a valid @ssot, if a BUILD_QUEUE step has contradictory assertions, or if an active mission blueprint has duplicate/unresolved step IDs.
Wire the validator into builder:preflight so every commit path checks blueprint authority before build.

steps.title: Chair/Council pipeline as runtime entry gate
required_edits: Create runChairConsensusGate that validates a reasoning plan before Builder dispatch.
Integrate the gate into dispatchExecuteStep so no step proceeds without a validated plan and Chair seal.
Auto-generate a deterministic plan with classification, budget, reality measures, and synthetic chair seal when none is supplied, to keep existing queues moving while preserving the gate contract.

steps.title: Prediction → Reality → Calibration loop
required_edits: Extend founder-intent-model with predictDecisionOutcome, recordDecisionReality, calibrateDecision, and getDecisionCalibrationSummary.
Create a verification script that proves the prediction/reality/calibration tables and functions exist and can record a full loop.
Document that every major decision must record a prediction before action and reality/calibration after action.

steps.title: Constitutional manufacturing pipeline ratification
required_edits: Add Article II §2.0K (Blueprint Integrity and Constitutional Manufacturing Pipeline) and §2.0L (Prediction → Reality → Calibration) to NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md.
Update BuilderOS system identity to 'constitutional manufacturing system'.
Record change receipts and continuity log.
